card4_paragraph.snippet: We looked for a pattern in the misses. The model tends to grow faster than the record in El Niño years and slower in La Niña years, and three of the five largest overshoots are 1991–1993, after Pinatubo. The misses show no trend. The model's growth follows the ENSO index more closely than the measured growth does, and the variance it lacks is in the part that does not follow ENSO.
